panels.title: Backup evidence
panels.description: Last successful all-project snapshot and dump-integrity check across the host. These do not prove a full database restore; missing evidence is not success.

panels.title: Production share of server
panels.description: Compare production projects by their use of this server. CPU share is usage divided by all host CPU cores; RAM share is container working set divided by total host RAM, not container limits. Infrastructure, staging and OS memory are excluded, so these shares do not add up to the host usage above. Missing metrics are Unknown, not zero. This is resource usage, not application health.

options.content:
{{#each data}}

{{project}}

CPU / server
{{share cpu}}
RAM / server
{{share ramShare}}
RAM used
{{memory ramUsed}}
{{/each}}
options.styles: & { overflow-x: hidden; } .dt-row { padding: 0; min-width: 0; } .project-pairs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; } .project-card { min-width: 0; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(127,127,127,.06); } .project-card h3 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .project-card dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 3px 6px; margin: 0; } .project-card dt, .project-card dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: 0; } .project-card dt { font-size: 11px; opacity: .8; } .project-card dd { font-size: 12px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .project-empty { padding: 12px; }

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: All firing alerts, ordered by severity. Expand details keeps the alert list on this dashboard. An empty result is not proof that the server is healthy.

options.styles: & { overflow-x: hidden; } .dt-row { padding: 0; min-width: 0; } .alert-list { padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; } .alert-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 4px 12px; padding-bottom: 8px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 20px; } .alert-toggle { min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 10px; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.5); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .alert-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5794f2; outline-offset: 2px; } .alert-item { min-width: 0; padding: 6px 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); border-left: 3px solid #8e8e8e; overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: normal; } .alert-item.severity-critical, .alert-item.severity-error { border-left-color: #f2495c; } .alert-item.severity-warning { border-left-color: #ffb357; } .alert-item.severity-info { border-left-color: #5794f2; } .alert-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 12px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; opacity: .85; } .alert-sample { font-style: italic; } .alert-item h3 { margin: 2px 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: normal; } .alert-target { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .alert-details[hidden] { display: none; } .alert-details { padding-top: 8px; } .alert-item dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,2fr); gap: 3px 10px; margin: 0; } .alert-item dt, .alert-item dd { min-width: 0; margin: 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: normal; } .alert-item dt { opacity: .7; }

panels.title: Alert history
panels.description: Sampled firing intervals for all server alerts during the last 24 hours. Red means firing; a gap means resolved or no sample. Hover a segment for its approximate start, end and duration. This history lasts only as long as Prometheus retains the underlying series.
